title: Replace or change number plates
summary: You can replace or change your existing NSW-issued number plates if they are damaged or worn through myPlates or at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If your existing NSW-issued number plates are damaged or worn, you can replace them with the same content and style (if still available) through myPlates or at a Service NSW Centre.

You can also:

You cannot order a replacement for number plates that have been lost, stolen or destroyed.
who_can_apply: Anyone who has number plates registered in their name.
what_you_need: Driver licence number or customer number (if a business)
Completed PDF form – 'Number Plates and/or Cancellation of Registration'

more_info.text: Fees will depend on the replacement option you choose. The least expensive option is general issue number plates (black and yellow).
Your existing number plate style may no longer be available for manufacture.

faqs.q: Can I replace number plates that were lost, stolen, or destroyed?
faqs.a: No, you cannot order a replacement for number plates that have been lost, stolen, or destroyed.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to replace number plates?
faqs.a: Anyone who has number plates registered in their name can apply.

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my number plates?
faqs.a: You will need your name and contact details, driver licence number or customer number (if a business), number plate details, old number plates, proof of identity, fee payment, and the completed PDF form – 'Number Plates and/or Cancellation of Registration'.
